stem: This bag is ____ than mine, but it costs much less.
explain_zh: than 前面要用比較級，big 重複子音加 -er 變成 bigger。big 是原級，biggest 與 the biggest 是最高級，都不能和 than 連用。

stem: Mount Jade is ____ mountain in Taiwan.
explain_zh: 在單一範圍 in Taiwan 中比所有山，要用最高級，而且最高級前面必須加 the。higher 是比較級，high 是原級，highest 少了 the。

stem: My brother runs ____ than I do, so he won the race.
explain_zh: than 提示要用比較級，副詞 fast 的比較級是 faster。fast 是原級，fastest 是最高級，單音節字不可以用 more fast。

stem: This math problem is ____ difficult than the one on page ten.
explain_zh: difficult 是三音節的長形容詞，比較級要用 more difficult。much 和 very 是程度副詞，不能直接接 than；most 是最高級。

stem: Of all the students in my class, Amy studies ____.
explain_zh: Of all the students 表示在全班範圍內比較，要用最高級 the hardest。harder 是比較級，hard 是原級，單音節字不能寫 more hard。

stem: The MRT is as convenient ____ the bus for going downtown.
explain_zh: as + 原級 + as 表示「和……一樣」，所以第二個空要用 as。than 只能接比較級，so 與 like 都不能形成這個句型。

stem: Today is ____ hotter than yesterday, so remember to drink water.
explain_zh: 要強調比較級可以用 much、far、a lot 等副詞，故選 much hotter。very、so、too 只能修飾原級，不能修飾比較級。

stem: Which is ____, a lion or a tiger?
explain_zh: 兩者之間做比較要用比較級，heavy 去 y 加 ier 變成 heavier。heavy 是原級，最高級用在三者以上。

stem: Health is ____ important thing in our life.
explain_zh: 「最重要的事」是最高級，important 屬長形容詞，要用 the most important。more 是比較級，most 少了 the，much more 也是比較級。

stem: My grades are getting ____ and better because I review every night.
explain_zh: 「比較級 and 比較級」表示越來越……，good 的比較級是 better，所以寫 better and better。good、well 是原級，best 是最高級。

stem: This is ____ movie I have ever seen; I almost fell asleep.
explain_zh: have ever seen 是最高級常見的句型，boring 是長形容詞，最高級為 the most boring。boring 不能加 -est，比較級也不合句意。

stem: Taipei is not ____ Kaohsiung in summer.
explain_zh: 否定的「不如……一樣」用 not as + 原級 + as，故選 as hot as。as 之間一定放原級，不能放 hotter，也不能和 than 混用。

stem: The more you practice, ____ you will speak.
explain_zh: 「the + 比較級, the + 比較級」表示越……就越……，well 的比較級是 better，前面要加 the。the best 是最高級，單獨的 better 少了 the。

stem: My sister is three years ____ than me, so she is in senior high.
explain_zh: 數字＋years 之後接比較級再接 than，old 的比較級是 older。old 是原級，oldest 是最高級，old 也不能寫成 more old。

stem: Of the three shirts, this one is ____ expensive.
explain_zh: 三件之中「最不……」要用 the least + 原級。less 與 the less 是比較級，little 是原級，都不能表達三者中的最低程度。

stem: A blue whale is ____ animal in the world.
explain_zh: in the world 指全世界範圍，要用最高級 the largest。larger 是比較級，large 是原級，單音節字不用 more。

stem: Winter in Japan is ____ colder than winter in Taiwan.
explain_zh: far 可以加強比較級，表示「……得多」。very、too、so 只能修飾原級形容詞，不能放在 colder 前面。

stem: He speaks English ____ fluently than his classmates.
explain_zh: fluently 是 -ly 結尾的副詞，比較級要用 more fluently 再接 than。most 是最高級，much 和 very 不能直接接 than。

stem: We usually have a big dinner ____ Chinese New Year's Eve.
explain_zh: 特定的某一天或節日當天要用 on，例如 on Sunday、on Chinese New Year's Eve。in 用於月份年份，at 用於幾點鐘。

stem: The bookstore is ____ the post office and the bank.
explain_zh: between 用在「兩者之間」，這裡是郵局和銀行兩個地方。among 用於三者以上，during 是時間介系詞，behind 是在後面。

stem: My father goes to work ____ MRT every morning.
explain_zh: 交通工具前用 by＋名詞單數且不加冠詞，如 by MRT、by bus。on 要說 on the MRT，with 表示工具，in 用於車內。

stem: The class will begin ____ eight thirty, so don't be late.
explain_zh: 明確的鐘點時間用 at，如 at eight thirty。on 接日期，in 接月份、季節或年份。

stem: She has lived in Tainan ____ 2019.
explain_zh: since 後面接「時間起點」，2019 是起點且搭配現在完成式。for 後面接一段時間長度，during 接事件期間。

stem: I waited for the bus ____ twenty minutes in the heavy rain.
explain_zh: for 後面接一段時間長度 twenty minutes。since 接時間起點，during 接名詞事件，until 表示「直到」。

stem: I fell asleep ____ the long and quiet movie last night.
explain_zh: during 是介系詞，後面接名詞 the movie。while 是連接詞要接句子，for 接時間長度，since 接時間起點。

stem: The cat is hiding ____ the sofa; I can only see its tail.
explain_zh: 只看得到尾巴，表示貓躲在沙發「後面」，用 behind。among 是在三者以上之中，through 是穿過，across 是橫越。

stem: The train went ____ a long tunnel in the mountain.
explain_zh: through 表示從內部穿過，隧道是立體空間。across 是橫越表面，above 是在上方，between 是在兩者之間。

stem: My grandma was born ____ May, 1955.
explain_zh: 月份與年份前用 in，如 in May、in 1955。on 用於特定日期，at 用於鐘點。

stem: Hang the picture ____ the sofa so that everyone can see it.
explain_zh: above 表示在上方較高的位置，畫掛在沙發上方。under 與 below 是在下方，into 是進入某物內部。

stem: She is good ____ playing the piano and often performs at school.
explain_zh: be good at 是固定用法，表示擅長某事，at 後面接動名詞。be good in、on、for 都不是這個意思的搭配。

stem: Don't worry ____ the test; you have studied very hard.
explain_zh: worry about 是固定搭配，表示擔心某事。worry for、of、with 都不是正確的動詞片語。

stem: I am interested ____ learning how to cook Italian food.
explain_zh: be interested in 是固定用法，in 後面接名詞或動名詞 learning。其他介系詞都不能和 interested 搭配。

stem: The school library is ____ the third floor of that building.
explain_zh: 樓層前面用 on，如 on the third floor。in 用於空間內部，at 用於地點的一個點。

stem: He put the letter ____ his pocket and left the house quietly.
explain_zh: into 表示移動到內部，把信放進口袋。onto 是放到表面上，out of 是拿出來，off 是離開表面，都與句意不符。

stem: Wait for me here; I will be back ____ ten minutes.
explain_zh: in + 一段時間表示「再過多久之後」，in ten minutes 是十分鐘後。on 與 at 不接時間長度，since 接時間起點。

stem: The night market is right ____ from our school gate.
explain_zh: across from 表示在正對面。between 要接兩者，along 是沿著，through 是穿過，都不能表示「對面」。

stem: ____ it was raining hard, we still went to the baseball game.
explain_zh: 前後語意相反，要用 Although 引導讓步子句。Because 表原因與句意不合，So 不能放句首帶子句，But 不能和後面的 still 這樣搭配句首從屬子句。

stem: I was very tired, ____ I still finished my homework before bed.
explain_zh: 「很累」和「還是寫完功課」語意相反，用對等連接詞 but。because 表原因、so 表結果都不合理，although 是從屬連接詞不能放在逗號後這樣連接。

stem: Both my brother ____ I joined the school marathon last Sunday.
explain_zh: both A and B 是固定搭配，表示兩者都。or、nor、but 都不能和 both 連用。

stem: Neither Tom ____ his sister likes eating green peppers.
explain_zh: neither A nor B 是固定搭配，表示兩者都不。or 要搭 either，and 與 but 都不能接在 neither 後面。

stem: Hurry up, ____ you will miss the last train home.
explain_zh: 「祈使句, or + 句子」表示「否則就會……」。and 是「就會有好結果」，so 和 but 都不能構成這個句型。

stem: We stayed inside all day ____ a strong typhoon was coming.
explain_zh: 颱風要來是待在室內的原因，用 because。although 表讓步、but 表轉折、or 表選擇，都不符合因果關係。

stem: Study hard, ____ you will pass the exam without any problem.
explain_zh: 「祈使句, and + 句子」表示這樣做就會有好結果。or 是「否則」，but 表轉折，so 不用於祈使句後這種搭配。

stem: ____ I was walking home, I met my old English teacher.
explain_zh: While 是連接詞，後面接完整子句表示「當……的時候」。During 是介系詞只能接名詞，Until 是直到，Since 是自從。

stem: She not only sings very well ____ also dances beautifully.
explain_zh: not only A but also B 是固定句型，表示不但……而且……。and、or、nor 都不能和 not only 搭配 also。

stem: Please wait here ____ I come back with the tickets.
explain_zh: until 表示「直到……為止」，等到我拿票回來。while 表同時，since 表自從，before 會變成「在我回來之前等」語意不通順。

stem: ____ you finish your dinner, you can watch TV for an hour.
explain_zh: 先吃完飯才能看電視，用 After 表示時間先後。Until 意思相反，Although 表讓步，Unless 是除非，語意都不合。

stem: I will not go to the party ____ you go with me.
explain_zh: unless 等於 if not，表示「除非你陪我去，否則我不去」。if 會讓句意變成相反，because 和 although 也不合邏輯。

stem: Turn off all the lights ____ you leave the classroom.
explain_zh: when 表示「當……的時候」，離開教室時要關燈。until 是直到，although 是雖然，unless 是除非，語意都不通。

stem: It was already very late, ____ we took a taxi home.
explain_zh: 「太晚了」是原因，「搭計程車」是結果，用 so。because 會把因果顛倒，although 表讓步，or 表選擇。

stem: ____ you want to stay healthy, you should exercise every day.
explain_zh: If 表示條件「如果你想要健康」。Unless 是除非會使語意相反，Although 表讓步，So 不能放句首引導條件子句。

stem: My little sister enjoys ____ comic books on rainy afternoons.
explain_zh: enjoy 後面固定接動名詞，所以用 reading。enjoy 不能接不定詞 to read，也不能直接接原形或第三人稱動詞。

stem: We finished ____ the classroom before the teacher came back.
explain_zh: finish 後面只能接動名詞，故用 cleaning。finish to clean 是常見錯誤，原形與過去式也不能當受詞。

stem: Would you mind ____ the window? It is a little cold in here.
explain_zh: mind 後面接動名詞，Would you mind + V-ing 是禮貌請求的固定用法。其他三個形式都不能接在 mind 後面。

stem: You should avoid ____ too much sugar if you want to stay healthy.
explain_zh: avoid 後面必須接動名詞 eating。avoid to eat 是典型錯誤，原形與過去式也不能當受詞。

stem: He practices ____ the guitar for an hour every evening.
explain_zh: practice 後面接動名詞，表示反覆練習做某事。practice to play 不合文法，原形與第三人稱形式也不能當受詞。

stem: They decided ____ the mountain early on Sunday morning.
explain_zh: decide 後面固定接不定詞 to + 原形，表示決定要做某事。decide climbing 是常見錯誤。

stem: I hope ____ you again during the summer vacation.
explain_zh: hope 後面接不定詞 to see，表示希望做某事。hope seeing 不合文法，原形與過去式也不能直接接。

stem: She promised ____ me with my science project tonight.
explain_zh: promise 後面接不定詞，表示答應要做某事。promise helping 是錯誤用法，原形與過去式也不行。

stem: The two boys agreed ____ the last piece of pizza.
explain_zh: agree 後面接不定詞 to share，表示同意去做某事。agree sharing 不合文法。

stem: The baby stopped ____ as soon as his mother held him.
explain_zh: stop + V-ing 表示「停止正在做的事」，媽媽一抱就不哭了。stop to cry 會變成「停下來去哭」，語意不合。

stem: On the way home, we stopped ____ some bread for breakfast.
explain_zh: stop to + 原形表示「停下來去做另一件事」，這裡是停下來買麵包。stop buying 會變成「不再買麵包」，語意不合。

stem: Remember ____ the door when you leave the house tomorrow.
explain_zh: remember to + 原形表示「記得去做還沒做的事」。remember locking 是回想已經做過的事，和 tomorrow 矛盾。

stem: I still remember ____ this song at the concert last year.
explain_zh: remember + V-ing 表示「記得做過的事」，last year 提示是過去的經驗。remember to hear 是記得要去聽，語意不合。

stem: I will never forget ____ Mount Fuji with my family when I was ten.
explain_zh: forget + V-ing 表示「忘不了做過的事」，when I was ten 指過去的回憶。forget to visit 是忘記要去做。

stem: Don't forget ____ your umbrella; it will rain later this afternoon.
explain_zh: forget to + 原形表示「忘記要做的事」，這裡是提醒帶傘。forget bringing 是忘記曾經帶過，語意不合。

stem: I would like ____ a cup of hot tea, please.
explain_zh: would like 後面接不定詞 to have，表示想要做某事。would like having 不合文法，原形與過去式也不能直接接。

stem: It is important ____ enough water every day, especially in summer.
explain_zh: It is + 形容詞 + to + 原形是虛主詞句型，真正的主詞是 to drink。這個句型不能用動名詞或原形接在 important 後面。

stem: Mike keeps ____ his phone in class, and the teacher is angry.
explain_zh: keep + V-ing 表示「一直做某事」，所以用 using。keep to use 不合文法，原形與過去式也不能接在 keep 後面。

stem: You ____ wear a helmet when you ride a scooter. It is the law.
explain_zh: 法律規定屬於強烈的義務，用 must。may 和 might 表示可能或許可，could 表示能力或客氣請求，語氣都太弱。

stem: ____ I borrow your eraser for a moment, please?
explain_zh: May I...? 是有禮貌地請求許可。Must I 是問有沒有義務，Should I 是問該不該，Would I 不能用來請求許可。

stem: It is very cloudy. It ____ rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
explain_zh: might 表示「也許會」，符合看天色猜測的語氣。must 是很肯定的推測，should 是應該，can't 是不可能，都與 very cloudy 的推測不合。

stem: You look really tired. You ____ go to bed earlier tonight.
explain_zh: should 用來給建議，語氣最合適。must not 是禁止，can't 是不可能，would 沒有建議的意思。

stem: When I was six, I ____ not swim at all, but now I can.
explain_zh: 描述過去的能力用 could，句尾的 but now I can 也提示前面要用過去式。can 是現在式，may 與 must 不表示能力。

stem: She ____ speak three languages, including Japanese and Korean.
explain_zh: 說明現在具備的能力用 can。must 是必須，should 是應該，may 是也許，都不是在講能力。

stem: You ____ be hungry after running for two hours in the sun.
explain_zh: must 在這裡表示很有把握的推測「一定是」。can 不能這樣表肯定推測，may not 意思相反，need 也不能單獨這樣用。

stem: We ____ to hand in the science report before Friday afternoon.
explain_zh: have to 是「必須」的固定用法，後面接原形動詞。must、should、can 都是情態助動詞，後面不能再接 to。

stem: The sky is clear all day, so you ____ take an umbrella.
explain_zh: don't have to 表示「不必」，沒有必要帶傘。must not 是嚴格禁止，can't 是不可以，shouldn't 是不應該，語氣都太強。

stem: Visitors ____ feed the animals in the zoo. It is very dangerous.
explain_zh: 危險行為要用 must not 表示嚴格禁止。don't have to 是「不必」，might not 是也許不會，would not 是不願意，都不是禁止。

stem: ____ you please turn down the music? I am studying for a test.
explain_zh: Could you...? 是客氣地請別人做事。Must you、Should you、May you 都不是請求對方幫忙的正確說法。

stem: He ____ be at home now; I just saw him at the library.
explain_zh: 剛剛在圖書館看到他，所以推測「不可能在家」，否定推測用 can't。must 是肯定推測，should 與 may 都不合語意。

stem: ____ we meet in front of the train station at six o'clock?
explain_zh: Shall we...? 用來提出建議或邀約。Do we、Are we、Must we 都不能表達「我們要不要……」的提議語氣。

stem: You ____ better see a doctor if the cough gets worse.
explain_zh: had better + 原形是「最好……」的固定用法。have better、would better、should better 都不是正確說法。

stem: Tom ____ to wear a uniform at his old school in Tainan.
explain_zh: had to 是 have to 的過去式，表示過去的必須。must、should、would 後面不能接 to，也不能這樣表示過去的規定。

stem: This long bridge ____ in 1998 by a Japanese company.
explain_zh: 橋是被建造的，且時間 1998 是過去，要用過去式被動 was built。built 是主動，is built 時態錯誤，has built 是主動完成式。

stem: English ____ in many countries around the world today.
explain_zh: 英語是「被說」的，現在的事實用現在式被動 is spoken。speaks 與 spoke 是主動，is speaking 是主動進行式。

stem: The classroom ____ every day by the students on duty.
explain_zh: 教室是被打掃的，every day 表示現在的習慣，用 is cleaned。其他三個都是主動形式。

stem: My bike ____ last night, so I took the bus this morning.
explain_zh: 腳踏車是被偷的，last night 是過去，用 was stolen。stole 與 was stealing 是主動，is stolen 時態不對。

stem: These delicious cookies ____ by my grandmother yesterday.
explain_zh: 餅乾是被做出來的，主詞複數且時間是昨天，用 were made。made 是主動，are made 時態錯，was made 主詞單複數不合。

stem: All the invitation letters will ____ tomorrow morning.
explain_zh: will 後面接原形，被動語態為 will be + 過去分詞，故選 be sent。send 與 sent 缺少 be，be sending 是進行式主動。

stem: Many windows ____ by the strong wind during the typhoon.
explain_zh: 窗戶是被風吹破的，過去的事且主詞複數，用 were broken。broke 與 were breaking 是主動，are broken 時態錯誤。

stem: Paper ____ from trees, so we should save every sheet.
explain_zh: 紙是被製造出來的，敘述普遍事實用現在式被動 is made from。makes 和 made 是主動，is making 是主動進行式。

stem: That popular song ____ by a famous singer last year.
explain_zh: 歌是被唱的，last year 是過去，用 was sung。sang 與 was singing 是主動，is sung 時態不符。

stem: Many young trees ____ on our campus every spring.
explain_zh: 樹是被種下的，every spring 表示現在的習慣，主詞複數用 are planted。其他選項都是主動形式。

stem: The math homework must ____ before Friday afternoon.
explain_zh: must 後面接原形，被動要用 must be + 過去分詞。hand in 與 handed in 缺少 be，being handed in 不能接在 must 後面。

stem: This beautiful picture ____ by a student in our class.
explain_zh: 畫是被畫出來的，要用被動語態 was drawn。drew、draws、is drawing 都是主動形式，主詞變成畫自己在畫圖。

stem: You are in the ninth grade this year, ____?
explain_zh: 附加問句要「前肯後否」，主要子句用 are，所以附加問句是 aren't you。are you 沒有變否定，don't you 助動詞錯，isn't it 主詞錯。

stem: Your sister doesn't like drinking coffee, ____?
explain_zh: 主要子句是否定，附加問句要用肯定，而且要和 doesn't 一致用 does，主詞代換成 she。doesn't she 重複否定，is she 助動詞錯。

stem: Let's go hiking in Yangmingshan this Sunday, ____?
explain_zh: Let's 開頭的句子，附加問句固定用 shall we。will you 用在祈使句，do we 與 don't we 都不正確。

stem: Tom went to the dentist with his mother yesterday, ____?
explain_zh: 主要子句是過去式肯定句，附加問句要用 didn't he。did he 沒有否定，doesn't he 時態錯，wasn't he 助動詞錯。

stem: Open the window and let the fresh air in, ____?
explain_zh: 祈使句的附加問句用 will you。shall we 用在 Let's 句型，do you 和 aren't you 都不能接在祈使句後面。

stem: They have already finished the group project, ____?
explain_zh: 現在完成式的附加問句用 haven't they。have they 沒有否定，didn't they 與 don't they 助動詞不一致。

stem: There is a big night market near your house, ____?
explain_zh: There is 句型的附加問句主詞仍用 there，且要否定，故用 isn't there。isn't it 主詞錯，aren't there 單複數錯。

stem: You can't drive a car by yourself yet, ____?
explain_zh: 主要子句是否定 can't，附加問句要改成肯定的 can you。can't you 重複否定，do you 助動詞不一致，could you 時態不對。

stem: Amy will join the English club next semester, ____?
explain_zh: 未來式肯定句的附加問句用 won't she。will she 沒有否定，doesn't she 與 isn't she 助動詞不一致。

stem: I ____ my homework when the earthquake suddenly happened.
explain_zh: when 引導的短暫動作發生時，正在進行的動作用過去進行式 was doing。did 是單純過去，am doing 是現在進行，have done 是完成式。

stem: While my sister ____ on the phone, the doorbell rang loudly.
explain_zh: While 引導的長動作要用過去進行式 was talking，搭配後面的過去式 rang。talked、talks、is talking 都無法表示當時正在進行。

stem: At eight o'clock last night, we ____ dinner together at home.
explain_zh: at eight o'clock last night 指過去某一時刻正在做的事，用過去進行式 were having。have 與 are having 時態錯，had been 後面不能直接接受詞。

stem: They ____ basketball when it suddenly started to rain hard.
explain_zh: 突然下雨時正在進行的動作用過去進行式 were playing。played 只表示過去發生，are playing 是現在進行，have played 是完成式。

stem: The students ____ quietly when the principal walked into the room.
explain_zh: 校長走進來的那一刻學生正在閱讀，用過去進行式 were reading。read 無法強調當時正在進行，其他兩個時態也不對。

stem: It ____ heavily when we walked out of the MRT station.
explain_zh: 走出捷運站時雨正在下，用過去進行式 was raining。rains 與 is raining 是現在的時態，has rained 是完成式。

stem: My parents were watching TV while I ____ the dishes.
explain_zh: while 連接兩個同時進行的過去動作，前面是 were watching，後面也要用過去進行式 was washing。其他選項時態不一致。

stem: He ____ for the bus when his uncle drove by and stopped.
explain_zh: 叔叔開車經過時他正在等公車，用過去進行式 was waiting。waits 與 is waiting 是現在式，has waited 是完成式。

stem: I ____ across the street when someone suddenly called my name.
explain_zh: 有人叫我名字時我正在過馬路，用過去進行式 was walking。其他三個選項都無法表達過去某時正在進行的動作。

stem: The baby ____ peacefully when his mother came into the room.
explain_zh: 媽媽進房間時寶寶正在睡覺，用過去進行式 was sleeping。sleeps 是現在習慣，is sleeping 是現在進行，has slept 是完成式。

stem: We ____ about the coming test when the teacher came in.
explain_zh: 老師進來時我們正在討論考試，用過去進行式 were talking。talk 與 are talking 是現在的時態，have talked 是完成式。

stem: She ____ a shower, so she didn't answer your phone call.
explain_zh: 她沒接電話是因為當時正在洗澡，用過去進行式 was taking。takes 與 is taking 是現在式，has taken 無法說明當時的狀態。

stem: The soup is ____ hot that I cannot drink it right now.
explain_zh: so + 形容詞 + that 子句表示「如此……以至於」。such 後面要接名詞，too 和 very 都不能搭配 that 子句。

stem: It was ____ a nice day that we decided to go to the beach.
explain_zh: such + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that 子句是固定句型。so 後面要直接接形容詞，too 與 very 不能接 that 子句。

stem: He is ____ young to watch this movie by himself.
explain_zh: too + 形容詞 + to + 原形表示「太……而不能」。so 與 such 不能形成這個句型，enough 要放在形容詞後面。

stem: She is old ____ to take good care of herself now.
explain_zh: enough 修飾形容詞時要放在形容詞後面，old enough to 表示「夠大到可以」。too old to 意思相反，so 與 such 都不合句型。

stem: The box is too heavy for me ____ upstairs alone.
explain_zh: too...for someone to + 原形是固定句型，故用 to carry。動名詞、原形與過去式都不能放在這個位置。

stem: It was ____ exciting game that nobody left before the end.
explain_zh: such + a/an + 形容詞 + 名詞，exciting 是母音開頭要用 an，故選 such an。so 後面不能接冠詞，such a 冠詞用錯。

stem: There is not ____ time to finish the whole test paper.
explain_zh: enough 修飾名詞 time 時放在名詞前面，not enough time 表示時間不夠。too、so、such 都不能直接修飾名詞表示數量足夠。

stem: This coffee is ____ sweet for me; I really cannot finish it.
explain_zh: too + 形容詞 + for someone 表示「對某人來說太……」。enough 要放在形容詞後，such 接名詞，so 不能這樣搭配 for me。

stem: The movie was ____ boring that half of the audience left early.
explain_zh: so + 形容詞 + that 子句表示程度造成的結果。such 後面需要名詞，too 與 very 不能接 that 子句。

stem: He ran fast ____ to catch the last bus back home.
explain_zh: enough 修飾副詞 fast 時要放在後面，fast enough to 表示「快到足以」。too fast to 意思相反，so 與 much 都不合句型。

stem: They are ____ kind people that everyone in town likes them.
explain_zh: such + 形容詞 + 複數名詞 + that 子句，people 是名詞所以用 such。so 後面只能接形容詞或副詞，too 與 very 不接 that 子句。

stem: I was ____ tired to walk any further, so I took a taxi.
explain_zh: too + 形容詞 + to + 原形表示「太累而無法再走」。so 要搭 that 子句，enough 位置錯誤，such 要接名詞。

stem: ____ is the weather like in Taipei in March?
explain_zh: 問天氣的固定句型是 What is the weather like?。How is the weather? 雖然存在，但不能和 like 連用，Which 與 Why 都不合。

stem: ____ do you go to the library? — About twice a week.
explain_zh: 回答 twice a week 是頻率，所以問句用 How often。How long 問時間長度，How many 問數量，When 問時間點。

stem: ____ bag is this? It has your English name on it.
explain_zh: 問所有權且後面接名詞 bag，要用 Whose。Who's 是 who is 的縮寫，Who 不能直接修飾名詞，Which 是問哪一個。

stem: ____ did you stay in Japan last winter? — For ten days.
explain_zh: 回答 For ten days 是一段時間，問句用 How long。How often 問頻率，How far 問距離，When 問時間點。

stem: ____ is it from your home to school? — About two kilometers.
explain_zh: 回答是距離兩公里，問距離用 How far。How long 問長度或時間，How much 問價錢或不可數數量，How many 問可數數量。

stem: ____ do you like better, apples or bananas?
explain_zh: 在兩個明確選項之間做選擇要用 Which。What 用於範圍不限定的提問，Who 問人，Whose 問所有權。

stem: ____ were you absent yesterday? — Because I had a bad fever.
explain_zh: 回答以 Because 開頭表示原因，問句要用 Why。When 問時間，How 問方式，What 問事物。

stem: ____ students are there in your class? — Thirty-five.
explain_zh: students 是可數名詞複數，問數量用 How many。How much 用於不可數名詞，How often 問頻率，How long 問長度。

stem: ____ taught you to make this lovely cake? — My aunt did.
explain_zh: 回答是 My aunt，問人且當主詞要用 Who。Whose 問所有權，Whom 當受詞用，Which 用於選擇。

stem: My father ____ drinks coffee at night because he cannot sleep.
explain_zh: 因為喝了睡不著，所以是「從不」在晚上喝咖啡，用 never。always、usually、often 都表示常喝，與後面的原因矛盾。

stem: Lisa ____ late for school; she always gets up at six.
explain_zh: 頻率副詞要放在 be 動詞後面，所以是 is never。never is 位置錯誤，is not never 是雙重否定，never be 缺少時態。

stem: There isn't ____ milk in the fridge; let's buy some on the way.
explain_zh: 否定句中修飾不可數名詞 milk 要用 any。some 一般用於肯定句，many 與 a few 只能修飾可數名詞。

stem: How ____ water do you drink every day, Dr. Lin?
explain_zh: water 是不可數名詞，問數量用 How much。How many 接可數複數名詞，much of 與 a lot 都不能放在這個位置。

stem: There are ____ students in the gym, so it is very noisy.
explain_zh: students 是可數名詞複數，用 many 表示很多。much 與 a little 修飾不可數名詞，any 通常用於否定句或疑問句。

stem: I have only ____ friends in this new school, but they are very nice.
explain_zh: friends 是可數複數，而且後面說他們人很好，屬肯定語氣，用 a few。a little 與 much 修飾不可數名詞，few of 後面要接 the 或代名詞。

stem: There is ____ sugar left, so we can still make a small cake.
explain_zh: sugar 是不可數名詞，而且語氣是肯定的「還有一些」，用 a little。a few 與 many 修飾可數名詞，few 是否定語氣。

stem: ____ of the students in my class wear glasses in the front row.
explain_zh: some of the + 複數名詞表示「其中一些」，動詞用 wear。Much 與 A little 搭配不可數名詞，Every 後面要直接接單數名詞不能加 of the。

stem: My brother hardly ____ watches TV on school nights.
explain_zh: hardly ever 是固定搭配，表示「幾乎不曾」。hardly never 是雙重否定，hardly always 與 hardly often 都不是正確搭配。

stem: I go swimming three ____ a week to stay healthy and strong.
explain_zh: 表示次數要用 times，three times a week 是一週三次。time 是單數形不合，timing 與 hours 都不能表示頻率次數。

stem: ____ student in our class has an English name and a nickname.
explain_zh: Every 後面接單數名詞且動詞用單數 has。All 與 Some 要接複數名詞，Both 只用於兩者且接複數。

stem: We don't have ____ homework today, so let's play basketball.
explain_zh: homework 是不可數名詞，否定句中用 much。many 與 a few 修飾可數名詞，lots 後面一定要加 of。
